note: The prompt versions the rag-api answers under. Each label is config.py's prompt_id@prompt_version, as /version reports it. Each value is the sha256 of generator.py's SYSTEM followed by DATED_RULE, in UTF-8 with nothing between them, as generate() joins them at the head of the prompt (SYSTEM alone when no packed chunk carries a date). A changed text is a new version: set prompt_version in config.py, add its line here, and keep every line already here, because a registered version never changes its sha256. make prompt-version (commands/prompt_pin.py) checks the code against this file.
